units: s per lap per (lap of tyre age)^2
method: Indirect inference. One global coefficient on (tyre age)^2, solved so the simulator reproduces what an extra pit stop actually cost teams, measured from finishing times with race fixed effects. Held-out lap times do not support the term, so it is a calibrated stint-length cost, not a measured tyre cliff. After this the sanity gate is no longer fully independent of the strategy layer and must not be reported as if it were.
